attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Nurse Registration and Nursing Education (RI Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Nursing-related CE presented, accepted or approved by ANCC or its local chapter, recognized professional nursing organizations, board-approved schools of nursing, or other bodies approved by the Board; 1 CEU = 10 hours
rules.alternatives: Current national certification (or recertification) as an APRN is verified at every renewal (NPs licensed without prescriptive privileges before June 17, 2013 are exempt from this).
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation at least 4 years; subject to random audit. One 6-month extension possible for hardship.

topics.who: Practitioners who prescribe Schedule II opioids: 8 h Category 1 CME or equivalent CE (opioid prescribing, pharmacology, adverse events, dependence, tolerance, SUD, alternatives), before renewal of controlled substance registration or within 2 years; DATA 2000 waiver training qualifies

rules.notes: The 10-hour CE rule (§3.5) covers all nurse licenses, APRN included; no separate APRN hour count is set. Licenses expire March 1 every other year (odd/even by license number); renewal due before Feb 15.
